description: Use this when the user wants a region, resort or city inside one destination country and the regionCode is not known yet. Covers the regions of one country, not the list of countries and not offers. Lists the regions and cities of one destination country, with names and codes; a code narrows search_packages through its regionCode parameter. Read-only.

countryCode.description: Two-letter destination country code (e.g. 'ES' for Spain, 'GR' for Greece), as listed by get_countries.

name: get_regions
title: List regions and cities
